# YouTube sub-actions

## Add broadcaster information

Saves details about your YouTube account and your bot account as variables for the next steps. It has no settings.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastUser%` | Your channel name |
| `%broadcastUserId%` | Your channel ID |
| `%broadcastCustomUrl%` | Your channel's @handle |
| `%botUser%` | Your bot account's channel name |
| `%botIsSignedIn%` | True if the bot account is signed in |

<small>Type id: `youtube.addBroadcasterInfo`</small>

## Add moderator

Makes someone a moderator of your YouTube live chat. Needs a live stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.addModerator`</small>

## Ban user

Bans someone from your YouTube live chat for good. Needs a live stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%bannedUser%` | Name of the banned person |
| `%bannedUserId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%banResult%` | True when it worked |

<small>Type id: `youtube.banUser`</small>

## Create poll

Starts a poll in your YouTube live chat. Viewers vote right in the chat. Needs a live stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Question** | The poll question, like "Which game next?". |
| **Options (one per line, 2–4)** | The answers, one per line. You need 2 to 4. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%pollMessageId%` | ID of the poll, to end it later |

<small>Type id: `youtube.createPoll`</small>

## Delete message

Deletes one message from your YouTube live chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message id** | ID of the message to delete. The default is the message that started this action. Starts as: `%messageId%`. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.deleteMessage`</small>

## End poll

Ends a poll in your YouTube live chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Poll message id** | ID of the poll to end. Leave empty to end the poll Cuebot started most recently. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.endPoll`</small>

## Get latest monitored broadcast

Finds your latest YouTube live stream and saves its details as variables for the next steps. It has no settings.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastIsLive%` | True if a live stream was found |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | Its title |
| `%broadcastId%` | Its ID |
| `%broadcastUrl%` | Web link to it |
| `%concurrentViewers%` | People watching right now |
| `%likeCount%` | Likes |
| `%viewCount%` | Views |

<small>Type id: `youtube.getBroadcast`</small>

## Get user (channel) info

Looks up a YouTube channel and saves its details as variables for the next steps. Handy for a shout-out command.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userId%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%channelTitle%` | Channel name |
| `%channelUrl%` | Web link to the channel |
| `%channelDescription%` | Its description |
| `%channelSubscriberCount%` | Subscribers |
| `%channelVideoCount%` | Videos |
| `%channelViewCount%` | Total views |
| `%channelProfileImageUrl%` | Web link to its picture |

<small>Type id: `youtube.getChannelInfo`</small>

## Get video info

Looks up a YouTube video or stream and saves its details as variables for the next steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Video id** | The ID of the video (the part after v= in its web link). Leave empty to use your latest live stream. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%videoTitle%` | Its title |
| `%videoDescription%` | Its description |
| `%videoUrl%` | Web link to it |
| `%videoViewCount%` | Views |
| `%videoLikeCount%` | Likes |
| `%videoConcurrentViewers%` | People watching right now (live only) |
| `%videoPrivacy%` | public, unlisted or private |

<small>Type id: `youtube.getVideoInfo`</small>

## Remove moderator

Takes away someone's moderator role in your YouTube live chat. Needs a live stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.removeModerator`</small>

## Send message to channel

Writes a message in your YouTube live chat. You can use variables like %user% in the text.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message** | What to write, like "Thanks for watching, %user%!". Messages over 200 letters are cut into several messages. |
| **Send as the bot account** | Tick to write as your bot account instead of your own account. The bot must be signed in. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Fall back to the broadcaster** | Tick to write as you if the bot account is not signed in or fails. Untick to get an error instead. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.sendMessage`</small>

## Set category

Changes the category of your YouTube stream (the kind of video, like Gaming).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Category number** | YouTube's category number. Examples: 20 for Gaming, 22 for People & Blogs, 10 for Music. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.setCategory`</small>

## Set description

Changes the description text of your YouTube live stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Description** | The new description text. It can have several lines. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.setDescription`</small>

## Set privacy

Changes who can see your YouTube stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Privacy** | "public" = everyone can find it. "unlisted" = only people with the link. "private" = only you. Options: public, unlisted, private. Starts as: `public`. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.setPrivacy`</small>

## Set title

Changes the title of your YouTube live stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The new title, like "Playing with viewers!". It cannot be empty. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.setTitle`</small>

## Set title and description

Changes the title and the description of your YouTube live stream in one step.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Title** | The new title, like "Playing with viewers!". It cannot be empty. |
| **Description** | The new description text. It can have several lines. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.setTitleAndDescription`</small>

## Timeout user

Gives someone a timeout in your YouTube live chat. They cannot write for a while. Needs a live stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userId%`. |
| **Duration (seconds)** | How long, in seconds. Example: 300 for 5 minutes. Starts as: `300`. |
| **Broadcast id** | Leave empty to use your latest live (or about to be live) broadcast. Or type the broadcast's ID to pick another one. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%bannedUser%` | Name of the person |
| `%bannedUserId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%timeoutResult%` | True when it worked |

<small>Type id: `youtube.timeoutUser`</small>

## Unban user

Lifts a ban or timeout. It only works for bans and timeouts Cuebot gave during this session. For others, use YouTube Studio.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **User** | Who to pick: their YouTube channel ID (starts with "UC"), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. The default is the person who started this action. Starts as: `%userId%`. |

<small>Type id: `youtube.unbanUser`</small>
